title: Motovera Self-Leveling Green Laser Level 100ft LL-T2 with Tripod (New)

comparisons.notes: Product Code LL-T2, Motovera 100ft green cross-line self-leveling laser level with tripod, magnetic bracket, target plate, and carry bag. Same kit as Woot listing. Availability: 1.

writeup: Motovera's LL-T2 green cross-line laser kit self-levels within 4 degrees, is IP54 rated, and ships with an adjustable tripod, magnetic bracket, target plate, and carry bag. Woot has the new kit for $18.99 with a three-per-order limit and only a few left. Motovera's own site lists the same LL-T2 kit with tripod for $42.89 in stock, about 55% more than Woot.
